question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Salubrious
solution:
The correct answer is: **Beneficial**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Salubrious** means favorable to or promoting health or well-being.

 
 
• **Example -** *Vegetables are **salubrious** foods which provide essential nutrients.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Beneficial** means to produce good results or helpful effects.
 
 
• **Example -** *Regular exercise has many **beneficial **health effects.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that **'Salubrious'** and **'Beneficial'** are **similar in meaning**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vicarious** means to experience in the imagination through the feelings or actions of another person.
 
• **Insidious** means something that is unpleasant or dangerous, gradually and secretly causing harm.
 
• **Septic** means an infection caused by bacteria.
